handoffs.message: BFF handoff packet complete. Key findings: (1) CanonicalSnapshotAdapter fallback to seed is silent — _surface_status() reads a static env var, not adapter availability; (2) _load_or_seed persists seed to disk making it indistinguishable from real data; (3) snapshot param is accepted but unused. Suggested impl steps in packet Section 5.

Review requested changes: narrow command-path claims and fix frontend guidance that incorrectly treats any 4xx/5xx as backend unavailability. See support/sidecars/BP5-SVC-015/BP5-SVC-015-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF-REVIEW.md.

Addressed both review findings: (1) Section 2.4 narrowed to exclude ApproveEvolutionDecision and ExecuteEvolutionAction stubs — explicit-failure claim now only covers the four wired commands. (2) Section 4.4 command-submission guidance rewritten to distinguish BFF-local 4xx validation failures (role/MFA/params) from transport/downstream 5xx availability signals. Table in 4.3 also updated to match.

Re-review passed: sidecar packet now scopes the explicit-failure reference to the four wired commands and frontend guidance now correctly separates BFF-local 4xx validation failures from transport/downstream availability failures. Returned to Claude for owner closeout.
